name: antv-chart
licenseQuote: MIT License / Copyright (c) 2025 AntV Visualization Team
summaryEn: Makes 25+ kinds of charts (bar, line, pie, map, mind map, flow) from data you give it.
summaryKo: 데이터로 막대·선·원 같은 차트를 25가지 넘게 그려줘요.
capabilities: generate bar, line, pie, area and column charts
generate maps, mind maps, flow and fishbone diagrams
turn off single chart tools with DISABLED_TOOLS
guideEn: Pick the generate_* tool that matches the chart (for example generate_bar_chart or generate_column_chart) and pass the data and title; it returns a chart image URL. Use the DISABLED_TOOLS environment variable (comma-separated tool names) to hide tools your client cannot handle. Set VIS_REQUEST_SERVER to use your own chart service (GPT-Vis-SSR) instead of the default one.
guideKo: 그리려는 차트에 맞는 generate_* 도구(예: generate_bar_chart)를 골라 데이터와 제목을 넘기면 차트 이미지 주소를 돌려줘요. 클라이언트에서 안 되는 도구는 DISABLED_TOOLS(쉼표로 구분)로 끌 수 있어요. 기본 서버 대신 직접 만든 차트 서버를 쓰려면 VIS_REQUEST_SERVER를 설정해요.
warningsEn: By default the chart data is sent to a third-party render service (https://antv-studio.alipay.com/api/gpt-vis); do not chart private data unless VIS_REQUEST_SERVER points to your own deployment
Output is a link to an image hosted by that service, not a local file
warningsKo: 기본 설정에서는 차트 데이터가 외부 렌더링 서버(antv-studio.alipay.com)로 전송돼요. 비공개 데이터는 VIS_REQUEST_SERVER로 직접 만든 서버를 지정한 뒤에 써요
결과는 로컬 파일이 아니라 그 서버에 올라간 이미지 링크예요
runEvidence: README: npx -y @antv/mcp-server-chart; env table VIS_REQUEST_SERVER default https://antv-studio.alipay.com/api/gpt-vis (also src/utils/env.ts); DISABLED_TOOLS; npm latest 0.9.10 MIT with bin mcp-server-chart
concerns: No telemetry hits in the clone. The default renderer is a remote service by design; the README documents the private-deployment switch.
reason: MIT and npx verified, but by default your data leaves the machine to a third-party service, so not a default recommendation.
problems: Star count could not be verified; popularity set to unknown
Set recommend false because default behaviour sends data to a remote service
checked: Opened LICENSE, README env table and tool list, src/utils/env.ts, npm registry (version, MIT, bin), git ls-remote matched.

name: duckduckgo-search
summaryEn: Searches the web with DuckDuckGo (no API key) and fetches page text.
summaryKo: API 키 없이 DuckDuckGo로 웹을 검색하고 페이지 본문을 가져와요.
guideEn: Call search with query (and optional max_results, region) to get result titles, links and snippets, then call fetch_content on a chosen result URL to read the page text. Long URLs come back as short ref:// tokens that fetch_content accepts directly. Fetch requests are rate limited (DDG_FETCH_RPM, default 20 per minute).
guideKo: search에 query(선택: max_results, region)를 주면 제목·링크·요약이 나와요. 마음에 드는 결과의 주소를 fetch_content에 넘기면 페이지 본문을 읽어요. 긴 주소는 ref:// 짧은 표시로 오고 fetch_content가 그대로 받아요. 가져오기는 분당 횟수가 제한돼요(DDG_FETCH_RPM, 기본 20).
warningsEn: Reads DuckDuckGo web pages rather than an official API, so it can break or be rate limited (the README notes DuckDuckGo may answer with empty pages)
Queries go to DuckDuckGo and fetched pages are requested directly from their sites
warningsKo: 공식 API가 아니라 DuckDuckGo 웹 페이지를 읽는 방식이라 막히거나 깨질 수 있어요(README에도 빈 응답이 올 수 있다고 적혀 있어요)
검색어는 DuckDuckGo로, 본문 요청은 해당 사이트로 직접 나가요
runEvidence: README: claude mcp add ddg-search uvx duckduckgo-mcp-server; [project.scripts] duckduckgo-mcp-server = duckduckgo_mcp_server.server:main; PyPI 0.7.0
concerns: No telemetry hits. Scraping a search engine is fragile.
reason: MIT, updated in September 2026, no key, uvx start verified.
checked: Opened LICENSE, README, pyproject scripts, server.py (max_results, region), PyPI.

name: arxiv
licenseQuote: Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004 (LICENSE; no copyright line at top)
summaryEn: Searches arXiv, downloads papers and reads them as Markdown.
summaryKo: arXiv 논문을 검색하고 받아서 마크다운으로 읽어요.
capabilities: search papers by query, category and date
get an abstract by arXiv ID
read a paper or one section in bounded chunks
guideEn: Call search_papers first (query, category, date, sort; default 5 compact results), then get_abstract by arXiv ID, then download_paper to store it locally as Markdown. Read it with read_paper (12,000 characters by default, use start/max_chars to page) or read_paper_section; list_papers shows what is stored. Do not install it with npm: the npm package of the same name is unrelated.
guideKo: 먼저 search_papers(검색어·분야·날짜·정렬, 기본 5건)로 찾고, get_abstract로 arXiv ID의 초록을 본 뒤, download_paper로 마크다운으로 저장해요. read_paper(기본 12,000자씩, start/max_chars로 이어 읽기)나 read_paper_section으로 읽고, list_papers로 저장된 목록을 봐요. npm에 같은 이름의 다른 패키지가 있으니 npm으로는 설치하지 않아요.
warningsEn: Downloaded papers are stored on disk locally
semantic_search and reindex need the optional [pro] extra
An unrelated npm package has the same name; use uvx only
warningsKo: 받은 논문은 내 컴퓨터에 저장돼요
semantic_search와 reindex는 선택 설치([pro])가 필요해요
npm에 이름이 같은 다른 패키지가 있으니 uvx로만 써요
runEvidence: README: supported package on PyPI arxiv-mcp-server==0.8.2, do not use npx; [project.scripts] arxiv-mcp-server = arxiv_mcp_server:main
concerns: No telemetry hits. Optional free Semantic Scholar key only for citation_graph.
reason: Apache-2.0, updated last month, PyPI version matches README, no key needed.
problems: licenseQuote copyright line was not in the file head; the first line is Apache License text and the proposer's 'Copyright 2024 Joseph Blazick' was not seen at the top
checked: Opened LICENSE head, README tool table and install note, pyproject scripts, PyPI.

name: obsidian
install: In Obsidian, install and enable the Local REST API plugin (v4.0.0 or later) and copy its API key
summaryEn: Reads, searches and edits notes in an Obsidian vault through the Local REST API plugin.
summaryKo: 옵시디언 보관함의 노트를 읽고 찾고 고쳐요.
capabilities: search notes by text or tags
write, append and patch notes by heading
guideEn: Start with obsidian_list_notes and obsidian_search_notes to find notes, read one with obsidian_get_note, then change it with obsidian_write_note, obsidian_append_to_note or obsidian_patch_note (target a heading, block or frontmatter field). Use obsidian_manage_tags and obsidian_manage_frontmatter for metadata. Obsidian must be open with the Local REST API plugin on; the server defaults to http://127.0.0.1:27123 (enable the plugin's non-encrypted HTTP server) or set OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL=https://127.0.0.1:27124 for the HTTPS port.
guideKo: obsidian_list_notes와 obsidian_search_notes로 노트를 찾고 obsidian_get_note로 읽은 뒤, obsidian_write_note·obsidian_append_to_note·obsidian_patch_note(제목·블록·프론트매터 지정)로 고쳐요. 태그와 프론트매터는 obsidian_manage_tags, obsidian_manage_frontmatter로 다뤄요. 옵시디언이 켜져 있고 Local REST API 플러그인이 켜져 있어야 해요. 기본 주소는 http://127.0.0.1:27123(플러그인의 비암호화 HTTP 서버를 켜요)이고, HTTPS 포트는 OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL=https://127.0.0.1:27124로 지정해요.
warningsEn: Obsidian must be running with the Local REST API plugin enabled
Needs OBSIDIAN_API_KEY from that plugin
It can overwrite and permanently delete notes (obsidian_delete_note deletes without confirmation by default); limit with OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS, OBSIDIAN_DENY_PATHS or OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY
warningsKo: 옵시디언이 켜져 있고 Local REST API 플러그인이 활성화돼 있어야 해요
플러그인에서 받은 OBSIDIAN_API_KEY가 필요해요
노트를 덮어쓰거나 완전히 지울 수 있어요(삭제는 기본으로 확인 없이 실행돼요). OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS, OBSIDIAN_DENY_PATHS, OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY로 범위를 줄일 수 있어요
runEvidence: README: claude mcp add obsidian-mcp-server -e OBSIDIAN_API_KEY=your-api-key -- npx -y obsidian-mcp-server; env table OBSIDIAN_API_KEY required, OTEL_ENABLED default false; npm 3.9.0 Apache-2.0 bin obsidian-mcp-server
concerns: Only telemetry is optional OpenTelemetry, default false and set explicitly in env.
reason: Apache-2.0, updated 3 days ago, npx start and key requirement verified.
problems: Added default-delete behaviour and port details from the README
Copyright line not confirmed in LICENSE head
checked: Opened LICENSE head, README tool list, prerequisites and env table, npm registry.

name: youtube-transcript
licenseQuote: The MIT License (MIT) / Copyright (c) 2025 Junpei Kawamoto
summaryEn: Gets the transcript, timed captions and info of a YouTube video from its URL.
summaryKo: 유튜브 영상 주소로 자막(대본)과 영상 정보를 가져와요.
capabilities: get video title and channel info
guideEn: Call get_available_languages to see which captions exist, then get_transcript (url, optional lang, default en) for plain text or get_timed_transcript for segments with start times. For long videos pass next_cursor to read the next chunk. get_video_info returns title and channel.
guideKo: get_available_languages로 자막 언어를 확인한 뒤, get_transcript(url, 선택 lang, 기본 en)로 글만, get_timed_transcript로 시간 포함 자막을 받아요. 긴 영상은 next_cursor로 다음 부분을 이어 읽어요. get_video_info는 제목과 채널을 알려줘요.
warningsEn: Needs internet access to YouTube; heavy use from one IP can be blocked (the README documents proxy options, some needing a paid third-party proxy account)
The start command installs from the GitHub repository, so git must be installed; the PyPI package of this name is an older version (0.3.5 vs 0.8.4 in the repository)
warningsKo: 유튜브에 접속할 수 있어야 해요. 한 IP에서 많이 쓰면 막힐 수 있어요(README에 프록시 설정이 있고 일부는 유료 외부 프록시 계정이 필요해요)
시작 명령이 GitHub 저장소에서 설치하므로 git이 있어야 해요. PyPI의 같은 이름 패키지는 저장소보다 오래된 버전(0.3.5)이에요
runEvidence: README: "command": "uvx", "args": ["--from", "git+https://github.com/jkawamoto/mcp-youtube-transcript", "mcp-youtube-transcript"]; tools table with get_transcript, get_timed_transcript, get_available_languages, get_video_info
concerns: No telemetry hits. pyproject version 0.8.4 but PyPI latest 0.3.5.
reason: MIT, updated today, no key, command copied from README.
problems: Package field changed from pypi:0.3.5 to none because PyPI is stale versus the repository (0.8.4) and the command uses the git URL
checked: Opened LICENSE, README install and tool sections, pyproject, PyPI.

name: excel
summaryEn: Creates, reads and edits Excel workbooks (data, formulas, formatting, charts, pivot tables) without Excel installed.
summaryKo: 엑셀 없이 통합 문서를 만들고 읽고 고쳐요(수식·서식·차트·피벗).
guideEn: Start with list_workbooks or create_workbook, then read with describe_workbook and read_range and change with write_range, format_range or create_chart. Use import_csv and export_csv to move data in and out. Workbooks open only inside the folder given with --allow-dir; add --read-only to allow reading only, or --tools data,charts to offer fewer tools.
guideKo: list_workbooks나 create_workbook으로 시작하고, describe_workbook·read_range로 읽고 write_range·format_range·create_chart로 고쳐요. 데이터는 import_csv, export_csv로 주고받아요. 통합 문서는 --allow-dir로 준 폴더 안에서만 열려요. 읽기 전용은 --read-only, 도구를 줄이려면 --tools data,charts를 붙여요.
warningsEn: It can modify and overwrite workbook files inside the allowed folder (use --read-only to prevent that)
Writing VBA macros needs the explicit --allow-vba-write flag, which is off by default
warningsKo: 허용한 폴더 안의 통합 문서를 고치거나 덮어쓸 수 있어요(막으려면 --read-only)
VBA 매크로 쓰기는 --allow-vba-write를 줘야만 되고 기본은 꺼져 있어요
runEvidence: README: claude mcp add excel --scope user -- uvx excel-mcp-server stdio --allow-dir /path/to/workbooks; options table --allow-dir, --read-only, --allow-vba-write, --tools; [project.scripts] excel-mcp-server = excel_mcp.cli:main

name: searxng
summaryEn: Searches the web through a SearXNG instance and reads pages as Markdown.
summaryKo: SearXNG 검색 서버로 웹을 검색하고 페이지를 마크다운으로 읽어요.
